svg.text: How LiDAR separates the ground from what grows on it
A pulse that finds a gap keeps going. The deepest thing it reaches is what you want for a terrain model.
The last one back came the furthest, so it is the
Many pulses, sorted into two surfaces
DSM, red dashed — the top of whatever the
pulse hit first: canopy, roof, or ground
DTM, blue solid — ground returns only,
and the dashes ride on the blue
Under a building there is no ground return at all, so the terrain model is interpolated across the footprint.
